instagram.caption:
106 Thanksgivings of the Turkey Bowl. Nobody does Turkey Day football like Baltimore. Swipe through the day.

Calvert Hall and Loyola Blakefield meet again on Thanksgiving morning, and after the final whistle the pros play till midnight. You can create a squares contest for any of it. Click Create and type in the team names.

Youth teams and charities, half the pot goes to your cause. Link in bio.

#TurkeyBowl #Baltimore #CalvertHall #LoyolaBlakefield #ThanksgivingFootball

defaults.footnote: All times ET. Free to create. We never touch the money.

body: Calvert Hall and Loyola Blakefield meet again on Thanksgiving morning.
The whole city knows the score by lunch.
Youth teams and charities across Baltimore: the winner gets half, your cause gets half.
